\section{Advanced math}

\begin{align}
y &= \alpha + \beta x \label{eq:y} \\
z &= \gamma + \delta y \notag \\
w &\le z \label{eq:w}
\end{align}

\begin{equation}
f(x)=\begin{cases}
x^2 & \text{if } x\ge 0 \\
-x & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
\label{eq:cases}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation*}
A=\begin{pmatrix}
a & b \\
c & d
\end{pmatrix}
\end{equation*}

\begin{equation}
B=\begin{bmatrix}
1 & 0 \\
0 & 1
\end{bmatrix}
\label{eq:matrix}
\end{equation}

See \eqref{eq:y}, \eqref{eq:w}, \eqref{eq:cases}, and \eqref{eq:matrix}.

\end{document}
